changeSet.author: maxcit
changeSet.comment:
Tables,new: location points, the lost flag, and per-customer settings.
Points are deliberately few. A health worker's device reports its position on a schedule, and keeping a long history of where a named person has been is a liability, not a feature - so the normal retention is a handful of points per device and the table is trimmed on every insert. A device reported lost is the exception: it is tracked closely and its points are kept until it is found, because that is the situation the history is actually for.

changeSet.author: maxcit
changeSet.comment:
Column,new: trackAllDevices.
Whether the launcher collects a position at all is a per-configuration setting (configurations.requestUpdates), which defaults to DONOTTRACK. A fleet that wants routine location reporting would otherwise have to remember to change it on every configuration, and a configuration created later would silently opt out. With this on, the sync hook asks every device for GPS regardless, and the configuration setting stops being a trap.
Defaulted to TRUE because routine reporting is what this plugin was installed for; turn it off to hand the decision back to each configuration.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE plugin_devicelocation_settings ADD COLUMN trackAllDevices BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE;
